lines.text: All of our assault teams have been shot down!
I told you not to underestimate them!
How come we have to go to so much trouble over one little blue guy?
Blue guy? Are you talking about me? Blue? Huh? Are you talking about me?
No! Not you! The guy down there!
Curses! Our plan may have failed, but we can't let that blue guy off this easy!
For our fallen comrades! Battle stations!
